description: Rank candidate keywords, hooks or titles by demand evidence before choosing a wording. Checks live Google and YouTube autocomplete (free public endpoints; no SocialSeal charge) and reads Google search volume already stored for the workspace. Returns results ranked by evidenceLevel (strong/indicative/untested) with autocomplete state (exact/variant/extended/absent/failed), position and observed alternative wordings. Prefer an evidenced alternative over an untested wording. When ranking, also weigh Google volume and trend, surfaced-result response and engagement, and Explore relative-demand components where available; missing Google volume is unknown, not absent demand, and wordings still without a signal rank last. Does not fetch new Google Ads volume or TikTok autocomplete; use socialseal_start_search_journey or Explore for those. Saves nothing.
